summary: Workhorse Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreements with lender Motive GM Holdings II LLC. The amendment increases a cash-flow commitment from $20M to $30M, defers interest on the additional $10M until after September 30, 2026, reduces a customer-order commitment from $30M to $20M, and requires the company to issue warrants as consideration. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation.
